lanes.name: DFT formative assessment
lanes.expected_behavior: A synthetic teacher completes a fresh assessment through submissions, analysis, feedback, and two persistence reads.

lanes.name: AutoPAR
lanes.target_surface: autopar.pitchai.net and the staging web boundary
lanes.expected_behavior: A synthetic practice user traverses dashboard views, opens one sanitized completed case, loads 3D and PAR evidence, highlights a known tooth, and verifies the tooth-scoped popup.

lanes.name: AIPC / SkyBuyFly
lanes.expected_behavior: A public user proves coherent current card and PDP facts and safe commercial-control visibility, then proves historical and identity-only states suppress those controls.

lanes.name: AIPC / SkyBuyFly UI/API/browser hot path
lanes.expected_behavior: A read-only public run proves both dedicated HEL1 ingress boundaries, coherent current search and product facts, the visible card-to-PDP browser story, and suppression of commerce controls for historical or identity-only results.

lanes.name: potAIto / Aardappelprijs
lanes.expected_behavior: A synthetic market user reads the forecast, band, and freshness, switches snapshot and permitted model mode, and verifies raw-source and method provenance.

lanes.name: AFASAsk / GZB
lanes.expected_behavior: A dedicated synthetic GZB user asks an approved question, receives a completed sourced answer, and verifies the persisted conversation after reload.

lanes.name: Orthoparse
lanes.expected_behavior: A synthetic clinician opens one sanitized case, exercises STL, CBCT, editor, and compare, then proves a least-privilege short-lived share only in an approved synthetic environment.

lanes.name: QuickChat RSR
lanes.expected_behavior: A public traveller asks the stop-product question in the embed, observes progress, receives a source-bounded answer, and regains a ready input.

lanes.name: DePlanBook Play
lanes.expected_behavior: A synthetic participant completes the diary loop and proves fruit, activity, note, challenge, and exactly-one reward persistence after reload.

lanes.name: CISNL Maatje
lanes.expected_behavior: A public user advances Maatje through contribution and identity validation; final submission runs only against a proven synthetic staging sink.

lanes.name: AIGENDA Business Rules
lanes.expected_behavior: A public demo user searches and inspects a rule, authors a synthetic rule through clarification and validation, and commits exactly once in the isolated fixture.

lanes.name: DePlanBook CMS
lanes.expected_behavior: A public reader switches locale, searches a known published fixture, opens it, and verifies coherent title, body, navigation, and language.

lanes.name: Apologetica CMS
lanes.expected_behavior: A public reader searches or filters the library, opens a pinned article, and verifies heading, body, table of contents, context, copy-link, and responsive navigation.

lanes.name: AIGENDA calendar
lanes.expected_behavior: A synthetic planner creates and edits an event, finds it in Jaarkaart and Kalender, verifies matching ICS export, and cleans up the isolated fixture.
